decisive_items: Cardiac troponin I level was 25 ng/mL (normal, <0.023 ng/mL)
ST-segment elevation in leads III and aVR, Q wave in lead III, and ST-segment depression in leads I, II, aVL, aVF, and V2 to V6
response.rationale: Elevated cardiac troponin I level and specific ECG findings support the diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction, which is a more specific diagnosis than coronary artery occlusion

rejected.why: While subtotal occlusion of the left main coronary artery is present, it is not the most specific diagnosis given the clinical presentation and lab findings
Coronary artery disease is a broader diagnosis that encompasses the patient's condition, but it is not as specific as acute myocardial infarction
